session_selection_fix.root_cause: copySnapshot overlays live active/queue busy without a new published revision, while UI formerly redrew only on revision; generic busy plus UI pending also disabled cached rows during slow background or explicit list GET.
changes: Redraw on busy change even if revision is unchanged; existing scroll preservation and pointer freeze remain.
Enable session entry/valid cached rows during background reads.
Only SelectSession can supersede UI-pending RefreshSessions; send/login/create/ASR cannot be bypassed.
session_selection_fix.limits: Source/lifecycle checks only. No serial, network request, firmware build, or real-device UI test.

root_causes: Global HTTP busy was used as an interaction lock and every polling revision rebuilt the root; v16 busy redraw compounded visible flashing.
Drafts were retained on queue acceptance but no matching server-send acceptance ever cleared them.
interaction_v17.refresh: Only page-visible content affects the render signature. Busy, revision, status and elapsed time update existing labels/button states; they do not rebuild root or row hit targets.
interaction_v17.gating: Only a matching outstanding explicit write blocks another write. Background/explicit reads do not disable session browsing, composition or voice. Compose may edit next text during Send/SendQQ; confirmation and send remain blocked until ACK.
interaction_v17.selection: Visible row snapshot frozen while pointer pressed. _selectingKey blocks target-dependent actions until snapshot applies that key, clears on selection ACK/failure or a successful POST that supersedes the old selection.
interaction_v17.draft: accepted_send_request_id must match sent ID. Only the same session and unchanged submitted draft/textarea are cleared; edited next text and pending-navigation saved drafts survive. Rejected/uncertain sends retain draft.
interaction_v17.qq: Default AI-device deliver=false. Explicit QQ mode chooser: AI-QQ deliver=true, DirectQQ requires qq_send_available and confirm=true. Both channel modes require a target+text confirmation page before submit; no automatic send/retry.

layout.brookesia_visual_area: Existing App enables resized visual area; base_app sets screen size to visual rect and shifts screen to visual origin. Status bar/system gesture sources unchanged.
